typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TotalRU as double,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		CabinetUsage as string,
		InstalledRU as integer,
		SiteGroup as string,
		AssetName as string,
		PowerUsed as integer,
		PoweredDeviceCounts as integer,
		StrandedRU as integer,
		PowerThreshold as double,
		DataHall as string,
		PoweredServerCounts as integer,
		DCMFlavor2 as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		TotalConsumed as double,
		Powered3RUBlock as double,
		Tag as string,
		Powered2RUBlock as double,
		PowerFree as double,
		AvailableRU as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		TotalRU as double,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		CabinetUsage as string,
		InstalledRU as integer,
		SiteGroup as string,
		AssetName as string,
		PowerUsed as integer,
		PoweredDeviceCounts as integer,
		StrandedRU as integer,
		PowerThreshold as double,
		DataHall as string,
		PoweredServerCounts as integer,
		DCMFlavor2 as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		TotalConsumed as double,
		Powered3RUBlock as double,
		Tag as string,
		Powered2RUBlock as double,
		PowerFree as double,
		AvailableRU as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TotalRU,
		SiteName,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName,
		CabinetUsage,
		InstalledRU,
		SiteGroup,
		AssetName,
		PowerUsed,
		PoweredDeviceCounts,
		StrandedRU,
		PowerThreshold,
		DataHall,
		PoweredServerCounts,
		DCMFlavor2,
		NlyteID,
		TotalConsumed,
		Powered3RUBlock,
		Tag,
		Powered2RUBlock,
		PowerFree,
		AvailableRU),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
